note: Rejudged after handleDial (reactor_dial.go) replaced dialSourceUnreachable with !listenerCanReach to also refuse IPv4/IPv6 address-family mismatches with noReachingListenerError. Re-read RFC 2661 Section 5.8 ('If no peer response is detected after several retransmissions, (a recommended default is 5, but SHOULD be configurable), the tunnel and all sessions within MUST be cleared.'). The pre-tunnel reachability check does not touch retransmission: handleDial and locateTunnelLocked still pass r.reliableConfig() to newTunnel, and ExtractParameters, tunnelDefaults, reliableConfig, setMaxRetransmit and Tick are unchanged. TestRFC2661ConfiguredMaxRetransmitClearsTunnel is byte-identical: it configures max-retransmit 2 before tunnel creation, disables HELLO dead-peer detection, asserts L2TPTunnelEstablished through each of the 2 allowed retransmissions (negative: premature clearing fails) and L2TPTunnelClosed plus 'StopCCN sent; tunnel closed' on the next deadline (positive: a fixed default of 5 fails).
